# A6 GPU price helper (Claude), a windowed fixture measurement, not a headless test. It reads the
# viewport's measured GPU render time, which on this M1 is only reported under the Vulkan driver
# (a6/evidence/probes/gpu_time_probe.log). Run from the repository root:
#   godot --path godot --rendering-method mobile --rendering-driver vulkan --always-on-top --script res://tests/gpu_price_effects.gd
# Cases, each over FRAMES frames and REPEATS repeats, with the real level on screen at the B1 rooftop:
#   level, effects off | Effect A heaviest: 2 puffs alive at all times | Effect B heaviest: steam at
#   amount_ratio 1.0 after it has filled. The effects are instanced here as fixtures (not wired), so
#   the numbers are what drawing them costs, not what the game's drivers do.
const JumpPuff := preload("res://effects/jump_puff.tscn")
const HoseSteam := preload("res://effects/hose_steam.tscn")
const FRAMES := 240
const REPEATS := 3
const PUFF_AT := Vector2(1240, 240)       # on the B1 roof platform, in view of the camera
const STEAM_AT := Vector2(1278, 206)      # top centre of the blocking fire at full height (B3)
var game: Node2D
var vp: RID

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")

func frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await process_frame

# Mean GPU and CPU render time (ms) over FRAMES frames. `tick` runs once per frame for live cases.
func sample(tick: Callable) -> Vector2:
	var gpu := 0.0
	var cpu := 0.0
	for i in FRAMES:
		tick.call(i)
		await process_frame
		gpu += RenderingServer.viewport_get_measured_render_time_gpu(vp)
		cpu += RenderingServer.viewport_get_measured_render_time_cpu(vp)
	return Vector2(gpu, cpu) / FRAMES

func report(label: String, runs: Array) -> void:
	var g: Array = runs.map(func(v): return v.x)
	var c: Array = runs.map(func(v): return v.y)
	print("%-28s GPU mean %.4f ms (min %.4f, max %.4f) | CPU render mean %.4f ms" % [label, g.reduce(func(a, b): return a + b) / g.size(), g.min(), g.max(), c.reduce(func(a, b): return a + b) / c.size()])

func run() -> void:
	print("rendering method: ", RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method(), ", adapter: ", RenderingServer.get_video_adapter_name())
	game = (load("res://game/main.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate()
	game.test_mode = true
	root.add_child(game)
	await frames(2)
	game.camera.position = Vector2(1310, 180)
	game.hud.visible = false
	vp = root.get_viewport_rid()
	RenderingServer.viewport_set_measure_render_time(vp, true)
	await frames(60)
	var off := []
	for r in REPEATS:
		off.append(await sample(func(_i): pass))
	report("level, effects off", off)
	# Effect A: a new puff every 0.45 s keeps two alive at all times (CHANGE-BRIEF A-R3 peak).
	var puffs := []
	for r in REPEATS:
		puffs.append(await sample(func(i):
			if i % 27 == 0:
				var p: Node2D = JumpPuff.instantiate()
				p.position = PUFF_AT
				game.add_child(p)
				create_timer(0.9).timeout.connect(p.queue_free)))
	report("Effect A, 2 puffs alive", puffs)
	await frames(60)
	var steam: Node2D = HoseSteam.instantiate()
	steam.position = STEAM_AT
	game.add_child(steam)
	for e in steam.get_children():
		e.amount_ratio = 1.0
		e.emitting = true
	await frames(120)                     # fill: longer than the 1.6 s Haze lifetime at 60+ fps
	var steamed := []
	for r in REPEATS:
		steamed.append(await sample(func(_i): pass))
	report("Effect B, ratio 1.0, filled", steamed)
	quit()

2	# Jump puff driver (CHANGE-BRIEF A1, A4, Revisions 1 and 2). Presentation only: it reads player.landed and
3	# the player's global_position and adds a JumpPuff to the level node. It never writes game state.
4	# Every effect setting lives in res://effects/jump_puff.tscn; this only instances, places and frees.
5	const JumpPuff := preload("res://effects/jump_puff.tscn")
6	
7	func _ready() -> void:
8		name = "JumpPuffDriver"
9		get_parent().landed.connect(_on_landed)
10	
11	# A-R3 overlap: every landing adds a new, full puff; earlier puffs are never touched.
12	func _on_landed() -> void:
13		var player: Node2D = get_parent()
14		var level: Node2D = player.get_parent()                  # WalkerJumpman (A-R6), never the player
15		var puff: Node2D = JumpPuff.instantiate()
16		puff.position = level.to_local(player.global_position)   # A-R1: his feet at the emit
17		var left := [puff.get_child_count()]                     # an Array, so the lambdas below share the count
18		for emitter in puff.get_children():
19			emitter.finished.connect(func():
20				left[0] -= 1
21				if left[0] == 0:
22					puff.queue_free()                            # A-R5: freed when all three have finished
23			)
24		level.add_child(puff)
25		# Revision 1 (A-R8): just before him in the level's child order, so it draws over the level's own
26		# _draw() and behind Extinguisho. Not z_index: below 0 it would also go behind the buildings.
27		level.move_child(puff, player.get_index())
28

2	# Hose steam driver (CHANGE-BRIEF B1, B4, Revision 5). Presentation only: it reads player.hosing,
3	# session.fire_height() and session.level, and writes `emitting`, `amount_ratio` and the HoseSteam
4	# root's position. It never writes game state, `amount` or `visible` (B-R6).
5	# Every effect setting lives in res://effects/hose_steam.tscn; this only instances, places and drives.
6	const HoseSteam := preload("res://effects/hose_steam.tscn")
7	var session: Node2D
8	var steam: Node2D
9	var emitters: Array[GPUParticles2D] = []
10	
11	func _ready() -> void:
12		name = "HoseSteamDriver"
13		var player: Node2D = get_parent()
14		session = player.get_parent()                      # WalkerJumpman: the root's position is in level coordinates (B-R4)
15		if not session.level.has("blocking_fire"):
16			set_process(false)
17			return
18		steam = HoseSteam.instantiate()
19		for emitter in steam.get_children():
20			emitters.append(emitter)
21		steam.position = _fire_top()                       # at the fire before it ever emits, so nothing is released from (0, 0)
22		session.add_child(steam)
23		# Revision 5 (B-R8): just before him in the level's child order, so it draws over the level's own
24		# _draw() (the fire and the water stream) and behind Extinguisho. Not z_index, as jump_puff_driver.gd.
25		session.move_child(steam, player.get_index())
26	
27	# _process runs after this frame's physics ticks, so it sees the session's fresh `hosing` and fire.
28	# Position and amount_ratio are written first, so the first emitting frame starts at the fire top at
29	# the fire's strength. A tree pause stops this with the session, whose values then hold (B-R5).
30	func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
31		var hosing: bool = get_parent().hosing
32		steam.position = _fire_top()                                                                    # B-R4
33		var ratio := clampf(session.fire_height() / float(session.level.blocking_fire[3]), 0.0, 1.0)  # B-R3

# Hose steam driver (CHANGE-BRIEF B1, B4, Revision 5). Presentation only: it reads player.hosing,
# session.fire_height() and session.level, and writes `emitting`, `amount_ratio` and the HoseSteam
# root's position. It never writes game state, `amount` or `visible` (B-R6).
# Every effect setting lives in res://effects/hose_steam.tscn; this only instances, places and drives.
const HoseSteam := preload("res://effects/hose_steam.tscn")
var session: Node2D
var steam: Node2D
var emitters: Array[GPUParticles2D] = []

func _ready() -> void:
	name = "HoseSteamDriver"
	var player: Node2D = get_parent()
	session = player.get_parent()                      # WalkerJumpman: the root's position is in level coordinates (B-R4)
	if not session.level.has("blocking_fire"):
		set_process(false)
		return
	steam = HoseSteam.instantiate()
	for emitter in steam.get_children():
		emitters.append(emitter)
	steam.position = _fire_top()                       # at the fire before it ever emits, so nothing is released from (0, 0)
	session.add_child(steam)
	# Revision 5 (B-R8): just before him in the level's child order, so it draws over the level's own
	# _draw() (the fire and the water stream) and behind Extinguisho. Not z_index, as jump_puff_driver.gd.
	session.move_child(steam, player.get_index())

# _process runs after this frame's physics ticks, so it sees the session's fresh `hosing` and fire.
# Position and amount_ratio are written first, so the first emitting frame starts at the fire top at
# the fire's strength. A tree pause stops this with the session, whose values then hold (B-R5).
func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	var hosing: bool = get_parent().hosing
	steam.position = _fire_top()                                                                    # B-R4
	var ratio := clampf(session.fire_height() / float(session.level.blocking_fire[3]), 0.0, 1.0)  # B-R3
	for emitter in emitters:
		emitter.amount_ratio = ratio
		# B-R1, B-R2: written on a change only. Stopping is `emitting = false` alone (no restart, hide
		# or free), so steam already in the air finishes its life.
		if emitter.emitting != hosing:
			emitter.emitting = hosing

func _fire_top() -> Vector2:
	var fire: Array = session.level.blocking_fire
	return Vector2(float(fire[0]) + float(fire[2]) / 2.0, float(fire[1]) + float(fire[3]) - session.fire_height())

244				if player.test_control:

246				if water and near_fire and extinguish_ticks == 0:
247					extinguish_ticks = EXTINGUISH_TICKS
248					water_ticks = EXTINGUISH_TICKS + 60  # water lingers ~1 s after it is out
249					play_sfx("hose")
250			if extinguish_ticks > 0:
251				extinguish_ticks -= 1
252				if extinguish_ticks == 0:
253					fire_active = false
254			if water_ticks > 0:
255				water_ticks -= 1
256			player.hosing = water_ticks > 0
257			# Touch to rescue -- only while NOT in a fatal state, so you can't rescue THROUGH fire.
258			if not fatal:
259				for s in survivors:
260					if not s.rescued and s.area.overlaps_body(player):
261						s.rescued = true
262						s.area.set_deferred("monitoring", false)
263						rescued_count += 1
264						player.rescued = rescued_count
265						player.bag_types.append(s.type)
266						player.bag_in_flight += 1
267						player.play_actions([["grab", GRAB_TICKS], ["toss", TOSS_UP_TICKS]])

279				saved_popup_ticks -= 1

302	func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
303		if event is InputEventKey and event.echo:
304			return

307		elif event.is_action_pressed("mute_sfx"):
308			_toggle_mute("SFX")
309		elif event.is_action_pressed("confirm"):

328	func _draw() -> void:
329		if level.is_empty():
330			return
331		var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
332		var ink := Color("25354a")
333		# All visual assets are original Godot vector drawing, not recovered art.
334		# The A1 cream sky, grid, and hills are replaced by the generated ENV-BG (see _ready).
335		# Burning buildings — decorative facades drawn BEHIND the ledges (no collision).
336		for b in level.get("buildings", []):
337			var bl := Rect2(b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3])
338			draw_rect(bl, Color("e0cdaf"))                                         # very light brown wall (contrast for dark figures)
339			draw_rect(Rect2(bl.position, Vector2(bl.size.x, 5)), Color("a3855f"))  # roof cap (medium brown)
340			draw_rect(bl, Color(0.96, 0.46, 0.16, 0.18))                           # warm fire glow (keeps the burning read)
341			for wx in range(int(bl.position.x) + 18, int(bl.end.x) - 14, 84):
342				for wy in range(int(bl.position.y) + 16, int(bl.end.y) - 24, 34):
343					draw_rect(Rect2(wx, wy, 13, 17), Color("6f5c46"))
344					draw_rect(Rect2(wx + 2, wy + 2, 9, 13), Color("f2ecd8"))
345		for entry in level.solids:
346			var r := Rect2(entry[0], entry[1], entry[2], entry[3])
347			# Light concrete with a dark outline: the A1 navy (#25354a) vanished against ENV-BG's dark fog (#2c3547).
348			draw_rect(Rect2(r.position - Vector2(1, 1), r.size + Vector2(2, 2)), Color("1b2230"))
349			draw_rect(r, Color("b8b2a6"))
350			draw_rect(Rect2(r.position, Vector2(r.size.x, 4)), Color("438e7d"))
351			for x in range(int(r.position.x)+12, int(r.end.x), 24):
352				draw_line(Vector2(x, r.position.y+12), Vector2(x+7, r.position.y+19), Color("8f897d"), 1)
353		# Fire hazard drawn as bold flames, data-driven from the hazard rect. The VISUAL is
354		# enlarged for readability but the COLLISION (the rect, built in _add_area) is
355		# UNCHANGED, so the jump-over margins verified by flame-clearance-positive still
356		# hold. Flame tips stay below the player's jump clearance, so a cleared jump does
357		# not clip the visual.
358		# ENV-FIRE (generated flames) drawn over each hazard rect: the wide street fire uses the wide
359		# cluster, small ones a row of single flames. Visual only: the COLLISION is the rect built in
360		# _add_area, unchanged, so the flame-clearance tests still hold. The art reaches ~8 px above the
361		# rect, like A1's code-drawn tips, so it can look touched without killing (forgiving).
362		for entry in level.hazards:
363			var hr := Rect2(entry[0], entry[1], entry[2], entry[3])
364			var vis := Rect2(hr.position.x - 2.0, hr.position.y - 8.0, hr.size.x + 4.0, hr.size.y + 8.0)
365			if hr.size.x >= 40.0:
366				draw_texture_rect(FIRE_WIDE, vis, false)
367			else:
368				var n: int = maxi(1, int(round(vis.size.x / (vis.size.y * 0.55))))
369				for k in range(n):
370					draw_texture_rect(FIRE_SINGLE, Rect2(vis.position.x + vis.size.x * k / n, vis.position.y, vis.size.x / n, vis.size.y), false)
371		# Finish: a FIRE-ESCAPE window. Data-driven from level.finish; LOCKED until both
372		# survivors are rescued, then it brightens with a "JUMP OUT" prompt.
373		var fr := Rect2(level.finish[0], level.finish[1], level.finish[2], level.finish[3])
374		var all_saved := rescued_count >= survivors.size()
375		var glow := Color("e8792b") if all_saved else Color("6b7683")
376		var pane := Color("ffe08a") if all_saved else Color("aeb7c2")

extends CharacterBody2D

signal jumped  # emitted once per real jump (the session plays SFX-JUMP; sound never feeds back)
signal landed  # emitted when the landing pose starts: on the floor after more than 10 ticks in the air

const Tuning = preload("res://features/player/tuning.gd")
const HoseGlow = preload("res://features/player/hose_glow.gd")  # A5: glow material on `sprite`, driven from `hosing`
const JumpPuffDriver = preload("res://features/player/jump_puff_driver.gd")  # A6: a JumpPuff in the level on each `landed`
const HoseSteamDriver = preload("res://features/player/hose_steam_driver.gd")  # A6: one HoseSteam in the level, driven from `hosing`
var tuning = Tuning.new()
var enabled: bool = false
var tick: int = 0
var last_floor_tick: int = -1000
var jump_request_tick: int = -1000
var opportunity_consumed: bool = false
var require_jump_release: bool = true
var facing: float = 1.0
var rescued: int = 0  # survivors in the rescue bag (set by session; used for drawing)
var bag_types: Array = []  # survivor types riding in the bag, e.g. ["person","dog"] (set by session)
var jumps: int = 0
var test_control: bool = false
var test_axis: float = 0.0
var test_jump_pressed: bool = false
var test_jump_held: bool = false
var test_water_pressed: bool = false  # hose input hook for the scripted route / tests
# Extinguisho art: one static generated image per state, swapped in (visual only; never read by gameplay).
const ART_DIR := "res://art/character/"
const BOX := Vector2(20, 40)   # collision box; feet at the origin (CHARACTER-SHEET, collision option A)
const LAND_TICKS := 20         # landing pose holds this long after real air time (was 8: too fast to see)
const NOZZLE := Vector2(33, -27.5)  # hose nozzle tip in the hose pose (game px, facing right): the water starts here
# Rescue bag center per pose (game px, facing right): on his back at the hip, measured on each image.
const BAG := {"idle": Vector2(-10, -30), "respawn": Vector2(-13, -20), "run": Vector2(-8, -21),
	"jump_crouch": Vector2(-9, -30), "rising": Vector2(-10, -18), "falling": Vector2(-12, -16),
	"landing": Vector2(-8, -20), "hose": Vector2(-10, -19), "grab": Vector2(-10, -27),
	"toss": Vector2(-10, -31), "burned": Vector2(-10, -30), "celebrate": Vector2(-9, -27)}
var pose: String = "idle"
var art: Node2D
var sprite: Sprite2D
var textures := {}
var anchors := {}
var jumped_this_air: bool = false
var air_ticks: int = 0
var land_ticks: int = 0
var was_on_floor: bool = true
var hosing: bool = false        # water is pouring (set by session)
var bag_in_flight: int = 0      # survivors still flying toward the bag (set by session); their heads appear on landing
var action_queue: Array = []    # timed poses that override movement, e.g. [["grab", 15], ["toss", 27]]
var action_cancel_on_move: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
	name = "Player"
	collision_layer = 2
	collision_mask = 1
	floor_snap_length = 1.0
	var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
	shape.size = BOX
	var collider := CollisionShape2D.new()
	collider.shape = shape
	collider.position = Vector2(0, -BOX.y / 2.0)
	add_child(collider)
	var info: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ART_DIR + "anchors.json"))
	anchors = info.anchors
	for state in anchors:
		textures[state] = load(ART_DIR + state + ".png")
	art = Node2D.new()
	art.show_behind_parent = true  # the code-drawn rescue bag stays on top of the art
	add_child(art)
	sprite = Sprite2D.new()
	sprite.centered = false
	art.add_child(sprite)
	show_pose("idle")
	add_child(HoseGlow.new())  # visual only; the driver reads `hosing` and writes the shader's `glow`
	add_child(JumpPuffDriver.new())  # visual only; the driver reads `landed` and adds a JumpPuff to the level node
	add_child(HoseSteamDriver.new())  # visual only; the driver reads `hosing` and `fire_height()` and drives the level's HoseSteam

# Swap the state image. The anchor (bottom-center of the collision box in texture px)
# lands on the origin; the holder's negative x scale mirrors the art when facing left.
func show_pose(state: String) -> void:
	pose = state
	sprite.texture = textures[state]
	var a: Array = anchors[state]
	sprite.position = -Vector2(a[0], a[1])
	art.scale = Vector2(0.5 * facing, 0.5)
	queue_redraw()  # the bag follows the pose

# Timed state poses (grab, toss, respawn), played in order and held for their tick count.
func play_actions(steps: Array, cancel_on_move: bool = false) -> void:
	action_queue = steps.duplicate(true)
	action_cancel_on_move = cancel_on_move
	show_pose(action_queue[0][0])

func _update_pose() -> void:
	var on_floor := is_on_floor()
	if on_floor:
		if not was_on_floor and air_ticks > 10:
			land_ticks = LAND_TICKS
			landed.emit()
		air_ticks = 0
		jumped_this_air = false
	else:
		air_ticks += 1
	was_on_floor = on_floor
	if land_ticks > 0:
		land_ticks -= 1
	if not action_queue.is_empty() and action_cancel_on_move and (absf(velocity.x) > 8.0 or not on_floor):
		action_queue.clear()
	if not action_queue.is_empty():
		show_pose(action_queue[0][0])
		action_queue[0][1] -= 1
		if action_queue[0][1] <= 0:
			action_queue.pop_front()
	elif not on_floor:
		# A jump is one flying kick all the way; walking off a ledge is the meditating fall.
		show_pose("rising" if jumped_this_air else "falling")
	elif land_ticks > 0:
		show_pose("landing")
	elif absf(velocity.x) > 8.0:
		show_pose("run")
	elif hosing:
		show_pose("hose")
	else:
		show_pose("idle")

func reset_at(spawn: Vector2) -> void:
	position = spawn
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	last_floor_tick = -1000
	jump_request_tick = -1000
	opportunity_consumed = false
	require_jump_release = true
	test_jump_pressed = false
	jumps = 0
	rescued = 0
	bag_types.clear()
	jumped_this_air = false
	air_ticks = 0
	land_ticks = 0
	was_on_floor = true
	hosing = false
	bag_in_flight = 0
	play_actions([["respawn", 30]], true)  # snaps into the ready stance; any movement ends it
	queue_redraw()

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not enabled:
		return
	tick += 1
	var axis := test_axis if test_control else Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	var held := test_jump_held if test_control else Input.is_action_pressed("jump")
	var pressed := test_jump_pressed if test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump")
	test_jump_pressed = false
	if not held:
		require_jump_release = false
	if is_on_floor() and velocity.y >= 0.0:
		last_floor_tick = tick
		opportunity_consumed = false
	if pressed and not require_jump_release:
		jump_request_tick = tick
	var rate: float = tuning.acceleration if not is_zero_approx(axis) else tuning.deceleration
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, axis * tuning.speed, rate * delta)
	if not is_zero_approx(axis):
		facing = signf(axis)
	velocity.y = minf(velocity.y + tuning.gravity * delta, tuning.terminal_velocity)
	if not opportunity_consumed and tick - last_floor_tick <= tuning.coyote_ticks and tick - jump_request_tick <= tuning.buffer_ticks:
		velocity.y = tuning.jump_velocity
		opportunity_consumed = true
		jump_request_tick = -1000
		jumps += 1
		jumped_this_air = true
		jumped.emit()
	move_and_slide()
	position.x = maxf(position.x, 10.0)
	_update_pose()
	queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
	# The body is the generated art (sprite above). Only the rescue bag is still code-drawn:
	# the art has no bag, and rescued survivors ride in it (person or dog head per rescue).
	# Same drawing as Assignment 1, doubled, placed per pose on his back. Hidden until the
	# first rescue, so the empty bag doesn't cover the generated art.
	if bag_types.is_empty():
		return
	var f := facing                 # +1 right, -1 left
	var c: Vector2 = BAG.get(pose, BAG.idle)
	draw_set_transform(Vector2(c.x * f, c.y), 0.0, Vector2(2.0, 2.0))
	var ink := Color("1b2a3f")      # outline
	var skin := Color("e8b98f")     # face
	var bag_col := Color("e67e22")  # orange rescue duffel
	var bag_dark := Color("b8621b") # bag seam
	draw_rect(Rect2(-4.5, -4.5, 9, 9), ink)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-3.5, -3.5, 7, 7), bag_col)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-3.5, -3.5, 7, 2), bag_dark)
	# rescued survivors ride in the bag — a clear head per rescue (grows as you save more)
	for i in range(bag_types.size() - bag_in_flight):
		var hx := (-1.0 + float(i) * 4.5) * f
		var hyy := -7.0
		if String(bag_types[i]) == "dog":
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(hx-3, hyy-1), Vector2(hx-2, hyy-6), Vector2(hx+0.5, hyy-1)]), Color("6b4420"))  # left ear
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(hx+0.5, hyy-1), Vector2(hx+2, hyy-6), Vector2(hx+3, hyy-1)]), Color("6b4420"))  # right ear
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx, hyy), 3.2, Color("8a5a2b"))       # dog head
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx + 1.2 * f, hyy + 0.5), 0.9, ink)  # snout/eye
		else:
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx, hyy), 3.2, skin)                 # person head
			draw_rect(Rect2(hx - 3.0, hyy - 3.6, 6.0, 2.2), Color("3a2f1a"))  # hair
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx + 1.2 * f, hyy), 0.8, ink)        # eye

2	# A6 Effect A, jump puff (CHANGE-BRIEF A4, Revision 1 A-R8, Revision 2): the driver's rules, headless.
3	# Revision 2: the puff comes from player.landed (on the floor after more than 10 ticks in the air), not
4	# from the jump. Every landing comes out of the real game loop (res://game/main.tscn), driven by real
5	# keys through Godot Input: Space, D, A, R and Esc, plus Enter to start or resume and M for the menu.
6	# The test never emits `landed`, never calls the driver and never moves the player. It only watches:
7	# SceneTree.node_added for a JumpPuff added anywhere in the tree, each emitter's `finished`, each puff's
8	# tree_exited, and its own connections to player.jumped and player.landed, which record the tick, his
9	# feet and his air ticks at every emit.
10	# Two things the test does that a player can't: it enters COMPLETE through the session's own
11	# resolve_contacts(false, true) while he is in the air (the real route needs both rescues), and it sets
12	# the tree pause (the game never does).
13	# Not tested: a landing after 10 ticks or fewer in the air. Real keys can't make one on first_steps.json;
14	# its lowest drop, the 16 px step, takes 11 ticks (walk-off-landing reports the count).
15	# Run: scripts/run-test.sh test_jump_puff_state.gd 60
16	# What this cannot see: pixels or particle positions. Headless Godot draws nothing (CLAUDE.md,
17	# Headless facts); the look, the draw order on screen and the frozen frame are eye checks.
18	const Main = preload("res://game/main.tscn")
19	const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
20	const PUFF_PATH := "res://effects/jump_puff.tscn"
21	const KIDS := ["Flash:CPUParticles2D", "Puff:CPUParticles2D", "Specks:CPUParticles2D"]
22	const LIFE := 0.9      # A-R5: freed within 0.9 s (+ one frame) of its landing; the Puff layer's lifetime
23	const SHORTEST := 0.72 # the Puff layer's shortest possible life: lifetime 0.9 x (1 - lifetime_randomness 0.2) (A3)
24	const EPS := 1e-6
25	const SPAWN := Vector2(64, 320)
26	const GROUND_Y := 320.0  # top of the street ground (first_steps.json [0, 320, 448, 64])
27	const STEP_TOP := 304.0  # top of the 16 px step at x 160-208 (first_steps.json [160, 304, 48, 16])
28	const FEET_EPS := 0.5    # his feet rest this close above a floor's top (the body's safe margin)
29	var game: Node2D
30	var results: Array[Dictionary] = []
31	var failures := 0
32	var tick_s := 0.0      # one physics tick in seconds
33	var frame_s := 0.0     # one drawn frame in seconds: the "one frame" of A-R5
34	var jumps: Array = []     # per player.jumped, in order: {tick, pos, state}
35	var landings: Array = []  # per player.landed, in order: {tick, pos, state, air_ticks, on_floor, live_after}
36	var puffs: Array = []  # per JumpPuff added, in order: {node, id, tick, pos, parent, kids, emitting, finished, freed_tick, freed_state, samples, moved, max_dist}
37	var seen_landings := 0
38	var tree_pauses: Array = []  # [from_tick, to_tick] of each tree pause the test made
39	var max_live := 0
40	var looked := 0        # live-puff samples taken (once per live puff per frame)
41	var moved := 0         # samples where a live puff's root was not where it was made (A-R4)
42	var wrong_parent := 0  # samples where a live puff was not a child of WalkerJumpman (A-R6)
43	var in_front := 0      # samples where a live puff's index was not below the player's (A-R8)
44	
45	func _initialize() -> void:
46		call_deferred("run")
47	
48	func tick() -> int:
49		return Engine.get_physics_frames()
50	
51	# One frame, then one look at every live puff (after this frame's physics, before its _process).
52	func steps(n: int) -> void:
53		for i in range(n):
54			await physics_frame
55			await process_frame
56			sample()
57	
58	# Synthetic key event through Godot Input, as test_keyboard.gd and test_hose_glow.gd.
59	func key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
60		var event := InputEventKey.new()
61		event.keycode = code
62		event.physical_keycode = code
63		event.pressed = pressed
64		Input.parse_input_event(event)
65	
66	func tap(code: Key) -> void:
67		key(code, true)
68		await steps(2)
69		key(code, false)
70		await steps(1)
71	
72	func wait_for(cond: Callable, limit: int) -> bool:
73		var n := 0
74		while n < limit and not cond.call():
75			await steps(1)
76			n += 1
77		return cond.call()
78	
79	# One real jump: Space down until the jump is seen (at most 10 frames), then up.
80	func jump() -> bool:
81		var n := jumps.size()
82		key(KEY_SPACE, true)
83		await wait_for(func(): return jumps.size() > n, 10)
84		key(KEY_SPACE, false)
85		await steps(1)
86		return jumps.size() == n + 1
87	
88	# Space as he falls the last 12 px to where he jumped from: inside the 6-tick jump buffer, so the
89	# next jump starts on the tick after the landing (CHANGE-BRIEF "Jump timing").
90	func jump_on_landing() -> bool:
91		var from_y: float = jumps.back().pos.y
92		await wait_for(func(): return game.player.velocity.y > 0.0 and game.player.position.y >= from_y - 12.0, 90)
93		return await jump()
94	
95	# Onto the 16 px step with real keys, from the ground to its left: D held, Space at x 110, D let go at
96	# x 176, so he comes down on the step's top. True if that landing was on the step.
97	func onto_step() -> bool:
98		var n := landings.size()
99		key(KEY_D, true)
100		await wait_for(func(): return game.player.position.x >= 110.0, 90)
101		var ok: bool = await jump()
102		await wait_for(func(): return game.player.position.x >= 176.0, 60)
103		key(KEY_D, false)
104		await wait_for(func(): return landings.size() > n, 90)
105		return ok and landings.size() == n + 1 and absf(landings.back().pos.y - STEP_TOP) < FEET_EPS
106	
107	# In the air above the street ground (where every mid-air check below happens).
108	func airborne() -> bool:
109		return not game.player.is_on_floor() and game.player.position.y < GROUND_Y - FEET_EPS
110	
111	func check(id: String, condition: bool, observed: Dictionary) -> void:
112		results.append({"id": id, "status": "PASS" if condition else "FAIL", "observed": observed})
113		print(JSON.stringify(results.back()))
114		if not condition:
115			failures += 1
116	
117	# --- watchers: they read, never write ---
118	
119	func _on_node_added(node: Node) -> void:
120		if node.scene_file_path != PUFF_PATH:
121			return
122		var rec := {"node": node, "id": node.get_instance_id(), "tick": tick(), "pos": node.global_position,
123			"parent": node.get_parent(), "kids": [], "emitting": [], "finished": {}, "freed_tick": -1,
124			"freed_state": -1, "samples": 0, "moved": 0, "max_dist": 0.0}
125		for c in node.get_children():
126			rec.kids.append("%s:%s" % [c.name, c.get_class()])
127			rec.emitting.append(c.emitting)
128			c.finished.connect(_on_emitter_finished.bind(rec, String(c.name)))
129		node.tree_exited.connect(_on_puff_exited.bind(rec))
130		puffs.append(rec)
131	
132	func _on_emitter_finished(rec: Dictionary, emitter: String) -> void:
133		rec.finished[emitter] = tick()
134	
135	func _on_puff_exited(rec: Dictionary) -> void:
136		rec.freed_tick = tick()
137		rec.freed_state = game.state if is_instance_valid(game) else -1
138	
139	func _on_jumped() -> void:
140		jumps.append({"tick": tick(), "pos": game.player.global_position, "state": game.state})
141	
142	# Runs inside the emit, before _update_pose() zeroes air_ticks, so air_ticks is his time in the air.
143	func _on_landed() -> void:
144		var p: CharacterBody2D = game.player
145		landings.append({"tick": tick(), "pos": p.global_position, "state": game.state, "air_ticks": p.air_ticks,
146			"on_floor": p.is_on_floor(), "live_after": -1})
147	
148	func live() -> Array:
149		return puffs.filter(func(r): return r.freed_tick < 0)
150	
151	func sample() -> void:
152		if not is_instance_valid(game):
153			return
154		var alive := live()
155		max_live = maxi(max_live, alive.size())
156		if seen_landings < landings.size():
157			landings.back().live_after = alive.size()   # puffs alive at the end of the landing's physics tick
158			seen_landings = landings.size()
159		var player_index: int = game.player.get_index()
160		for rec in alive:
161			var node: Node2D = rec.node
162			looked += 1
163			rec.samples += 1
164			rec.max_dist = maxf(rec.max_dist, node.global_position.distance_to(game.player.global_position))
165			if node.global_position != rec.pos:
166				moved += 1
167				rec.moved += 1
168			if node.get_parent() != game:
169				wrong_parent += 1
170			if node.get_index() >= player_index:
171				in_front += 1
172	
173	func puffs_in_tree() -> int:
174		var n := 0
175		for node in root.find_children("*", "", true, false):
176			if node.scene_file_path == PUFF_PATH:
177				n += 1
178		return n
179	
180	# Puffs added in physics ticks [from, to).
181	func puffs_between(from: int, to: int) -> int:
182		return puffs.filter(func(r): return r.tick >= from and r.tick < to).size()
183	
184	# Seconds of unpaused game time from its landing to its free (tree pauses the test made are taken out).
185	func life(rec: Dictionary) -> float:
186		var ticks: int = rec.freed_tick - rec.tick
187		for p in tree_pauses:
188			ticks -= maxi(0, mini(rec.freed_tick, p[1]) - maxi(rec.tick, p[0]))
189		return ticks * tick_s
190	
191	# A-R5: within LIFE plus one frame; and not before SHORTEST minus one frame. Not LIFE minus one frame:
192	# with lifetime_randomness the last Puff particle can die early (unseeded puffs, no game: 1 in 400
193	# finished 3 frames early).
194	func on_time(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
195		var l := life(rec)
196		return rec.freed_tick >= 0 and l <= LIFE + frame_s + EPS and l >= SHORTEST - frame_s - EPS
197	
198	# A-R5: all three emitters finished, and the puff was freed in the frame the last one did.
199	func all_finished(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
200		if rec.finished.size() != KIDS.size():
201			return false
202		var last := -1
203		for t in rec.finished.values():
204			last = maxi(last, t)
205		return rec.freed_tick == last
206	
207	# A-R3 "full puff": the scene's three emitters, all emitting when it was added.
208	func full(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
209		return rec.kids == KIDS and rec.emitting == [true, true, true]
210	
211	# Revision 2 A-R1: the puff is the one added in the landing's tick, at his feet then, on the floor at
212	# floor_y, in PLAYING, after more than 10 ticks in the air.
213	func at_feet(l: Dictionary, p: Dictionary, floor_y: float) -> bool:
214		return p.tick == l.tick and p.pos == l.pos and l.state == Game.State.PLAYING and l.on_floor and absf(l.pos.y - floor_y) < FEET_EPS and l.air_ticks > 10
215

376				if not ratio_ok(s):

388			{"frames": S().size(), "frames_steam_index_below_player": behind, "frames_with_a_live_puff": with_puff, "steam_index_at_end": S().back().idx, "player_index_at_end": S().back().pidx})

# A6 Effect B, hose steam (CHANGE-BRIEF B4, Revision 5 B-R8): the driver's rules, headless.
# The condition (player.hosing) and the game value (session.fire_height()) come out of the real game
# loop (res://game/main.tscn), driven by real keys through Godot Input: W, R, D, Space and Esc, plus
# Enter to start or resume. The test never calls the driver and never writes hosing, the hose counters
# or the fire. It only watches: a Sampler node (process_priority 100, so it runs after the driver's
# _process; process_mode ALWAYS, so it also runs while the tree is paused) records one sample per frame.
# Three things the test does that a player can't: before each W it puts him on B1's roof in hose range
# (as test_game.gd and test_hose_glow.gd do; the walk there is test_game.gd's route), it sets the tree
# pause (the game never does), and it sets `visible = false` on the steam root (B-R6).
# Run: scripts/run-test.sh test_hose_steam_state.gd 60
# What this cannot see: particles. Headless Godot runs no GPU particle process and draws nothing
# (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts), so whether steam spawns, thins, finishes or freezes on screen, and the
# draw order on screen, are eye checks. This reads the node state the driver writes.
const Main = preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
const STEAM_PATH := "res://effects/hose_steam.tscn"
const PUFF_PATH := "res://effects/jump_puff.tscn"
const KIDS := ["Haze:GPUParticles2D", "Steam:GPUParticles2D"]
const AMOUNTS := [14, 40]          # B3: fixed, never changed at runtime (B-R3)
const FULL := 34.0                 # B1: the fire's full height, level.blocking_fire[3]
const TOP := Vector2(1278, 240)    # B-R4: the root is at (1278, 240 - fire_height()) while hosing
const EXT := 240                   # session.gd EXTINGUISH_TICKS: the fire falls to 0 over 4.0 s
const STAND := Vector2(1220, 240)  # on B1's roof, in hose range (test_game.gd, test_hose_glow.gd)
const SPAWN := Vector2(64, 320)
const EPS := 1e-6
const POS_EPS := 1e-3
var game: Node2D
var sampler: Sampler
var samples: Array = []  # one per frame, after the driver: {paused, state, hosing, h, water, ext, p, steams, pidx, puffs, id, parent_ok, idx, pos, vis, emit, ratio, amount, shown, proc}
var results: Array[Dictionary] = []
var failures := 0
var frame_s := 0.0   # one drawn frame in seconds
var tpf := 1         # physics ticks per drawn frame (1 at 60 fps)
var steam_id := 0

# Calls the test's sample() once per frame, after every other _process (the driver's included).
class Sampler extends Node:
	var take: Callable
	func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
		take.call()

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")

func steps(n: int) -> void:
	for i in range(n):
		await physics_frame
		await process_frame

# Synthetic key event through Godot Input, as test_keyboard.gd, test_hose_glow.gd and test_jump_puff_state.gd.
func key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode = code
	event.physical_keycode = code
	event.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func tap(code: Key) -> void:
	key(code, true)
	await steps(2)
	key(code, false)
	await steps(1)

func wait_for(cond: Callable, limit: int) -> bool:
	var n := 0
	while n < limit and not cond.call():
		await steps(1)
		n += 1
	return cond.call()

# Puts him on B1's roof in hose range (the one write a player can't make) and presses W. Returns the
# index of the first sample after he stands there.
func hose() -> int:
	game.player.position = STAND
	await steps(3)
	var at := S().size()
	await tap(KEY_W)
	return at

func check(id: String, condition: bool, observed: Dictionary) -> void:
	results.append({"id": id, "status": "PASS" if condition else "FAIL", "observed": observed})
	print(JSON.stringify(results.back()))
	if not condition:
		failures += 1

# --- the watcher: it reads, never writes ---

func in_tree(path: String) -> Array:
	return root.find_children("*", "", true, false).filter(func(n): return n.scene_file_path == path)

func sample() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(game) or game.player == null:
		return
	var found := in_tree(STEAM_PATH)
	var s := {"paused": paused, "state": game.state, "hosing": game.player.hosing, "h": game.fire_height(),
		"water": game.water_ticks, "ext": game.extinguish_ticks, "p": game.player.position,
		"steams": found.size(), "pidx": game.player.get_index(), "puffs": in_tree(PUFF_PATH).size(),
		"id": 0, "parent_ok": false, "idx": -1, "pos": Vector2.INF, "vis": false,
		"emit": [], "ratio": [], "amount": [], "shown": [], "proc": []}
	if found.size() > 0:
		var st: Node2D = found[0]
		s.id = st.get_instance_id()
		s.parent_ok = st.get_parent() == game
		s.idx = st.get_index()
		s.pos = st.global_position
		s.vis = st.visible
		for e in st.get_children():
			s.emit.append(e.emitting)
			s.ratio.append(e.amount_ratio)
			s.amount.append(e.amount)
			s.shown.append(e.is_visible_in_tree())
			s.proc.append(e.can_process())
	samples.append(s)

func S() -> Array:
	return samples

func both(values: Array, v: Variant) -> bool:
	return values.size() == 2 and values[0] == v and values[1] == v

# B-R3: amount_ratio on both emitters = fire_height() / 34, clamped to 0..1.
func ratio_ok(s: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var want := clampf(s.h / FULL, 0.0, 1.0)
	return s.ratio.size() == 2 and absf(s.ratio[0] - want) <= EPS and absf(s.ratio[1] - want) <= EPS

# B-R4: the root at the fire's top centre.
func pos_ok(s: Dictionary) -> bool:
	return s.pos.distance_to(Vector2(TOP.x, TOP.y - s.h)) <= POS_EPS

func first_from(from: int, pred: Callable) -> int:
	for i in range(maxi(from, 0), S().size()):
		if pred.call(S()[i]):
			return i
	return -1

# pred holds on every sample in [a, b), and there is at least one.
func all_of(a: int, b: int, pred: Callable) -> bool:
	if a < 0 or b <= a or b > S().size():
		return false
	for i in range(a, b):
		if not pred.call(S()[i]):
			return false
	return true

func brief(s: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	return {"state": s.state, "hosing": s.hosing, "fire_height": snappedf(s.h, 0.0001), "emitting": s.emit,
		"amount_ratio": s.ratio, "amount": s.amount, "root_at": str(s.pos), "water_ticks": s.water, "extinguish_ticks": s.ext}

func run() -> void:
	sampler = Sampler.new()
	sampler.process_priority = 100
	sampler.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	sampler.take = sample
	root.add_child(sampler)
	game = Main.instantiate()
	game.test_mode = true
	root.add_child(game)
	await steps(30)
	frame_s = root.get_process_delta_time()
	tpf = maxi(1, roundi(frame_s * Engine.physics_ticks_per_second))
	var tol := float(tpf) / EXT + EPS   # one frame of the fire's 4.0 s fall, as a ratio
	var fire: Array = game.level.blocking_fire

	# --- B-R1 and "No steam on scene load": one HoseSteam in the level, not emitting, preprocess 0 ---
	var found := in_tree(STEAM_PATH)
	if found.size() != 1:
		check("none-on-load", false, {"hose_steams_in_tree": found.size()})
		return finish()
	var steam: Node2D = found[0]
	steam_id = steam.get_instance_id()
	var kids: Array = []
	var pre: Array = []
	for c in steam.get_children():
		kids.append("%s:%s" % [c.name, c.get_class()])
		pre.append(c.preprocess)
	check("none-on-load", game.state == Game.State.MENU and pre == [0.0, 0.0] and all_of(0, S().size(), func(s): return not s.hosing and both(s.emit, false)),
		{"state": game.state, "frames": S().size(), "emitting": S().back().emit, "preprocess": pre, "root_at": str(steam.position),
		"level_fire": fire, "brief_top_and_full": [str(TOP), FULL]})

	# --- B-R1: not on start (Enter) ---
	var s0 := S().size()
	await tap(KEY_ENTER)
	await steps(30)
	check("none-on-start", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and all_of(s0, S().size(), func(s): return not s.hosing and both(s.emit, false)),
		brief(S().back()))

	# --- B-R1: W at the spawn, out of range of the fire: no hosing, no steam ---
	s0 = S().size()
	await tap(KEY_W)
	await steps(30)
	var c := brief(S().back())
	c.merge({"player_at": str(game.player.position), "hose_sounds": game.sfx_counts.hose, "fire_active": game.fire_active})
	check("none-out-of-range", game.sfx_counts.hose == 0 and game.fire_active and all_of(s0, S().size(), func(s): return not s.hosing and both(s.emit, false)), c)

	# --- B-R1: a jump and its landing (a JumpPuff, placed just before the player) start nothing ---
	s0 = S().size()
	await tap(KEY_SPACE)
	var puffed: bool = await wait_for(func(): return in_tree(PUFF_PATH).size() > 0, 90)
	await steps(10)
	c = brief(S().back())
	c.merge({"jumps": game.player.jumps, "landing_puff_seen": puffed, "steam_index": S().back().idx, "player_index": S().back().pidx})
	check("none-on-landing", puffed and game.player.jumps == 1 and all_of(s0, S().size(), func(s): return not s.hosing and both(s.emit, false)), c)

	# --- Attempt 1, a clean hose: start, the loop at five fire strengths, the root, the stop ---
	var a1: int = await hose()
	await wait_for(func(): return game.player.hosing, 10)
	await wait_for(func(): return not game.player.hosing, 400)
	await steps(60)
	var i_h := first_from(a1, func(s): return s.hosing)
	var i_end := first_from(i_h, func(s): return not s.hosing) if i_h >= 0 else -1
	if i_h < 1 or i_end < 0:
		check("starts-with-hosing", false, {"first_hosing": i_h, "first_not_hosing_after": i_end})
		return finish()
	var hs: Dictionary = S()[i_h]
	c = {"before": brief(S()[i_h - 1]), "first_hosing_frame": brief(hs), "frames_from_stand_to_first_hosing": i_h - a1}
	check("starts-with-hosing", not S()[i_h - 1].hosing and both(S()[i_h - 1].emit, false) and both(hs.emit, true)
		and all_of(a1, i_h, func(s): return both(s.emit, false)) and absf(hs.ratio[0] - 1.0) <= tol and hs.amount == AMOUNTS, c)

	var points: Array = []
	var strengths_ok := true
	for t in [0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0]:
		var k := i_h + roundi(t / frame_s)
		var expected := maxf(0.0, 1.0 - t / 4.0)
		var s: Dictionary = S()[k] if k < i_end else {}
		var ok: bool = not s.is_empty() and s.hosing and ratio_ok(s) and s.amount == AMOUNTS and absf(s.ratio[0] - expected) <= tol
		strengths_ok = strengths_ok and ok
		points.append({"t_s": t, "expected": expected, "amount_ratio": s.get("ratio"), "fire_height": s.get("h"), "amount": s.get("amount"), "ok": ok})
	var distinct := {}
	for i in range(i_h, i_end):
		distinct[snappedf(S()[i].ratio[0], 1e-6)] = true
	var z := first_from(i_h, func(s): return s.ratio.size() == 2 and s.ratio[0] == 0.0)
	var four := roundi(4.0 / frame_s)
	check("ratio-at-strengths", strengths_ok and distinct.size() >= 2 and z > i_h and z - i_h <= four and z - i_h >= four - tpf
		and all_of(z, i_end, func(s): return both(s.ratio, 0.0)),
		{"points": points, "tolerance": tol, "distinct_ratios_while_hosing": distinct.size(), "zero_from_s": (z - i_h) * frame_s if z > 0 else -1.0})

	var moved: float = S()[i_end - 1].pos.y - hs.pos.y
	check("position-follows-fire", all_of(i_h, i_end, func(s): return pos_ok(s)) and absf(moved - hs.h) <= POS_EPS,
		{"hosing_frames": i_end - i_h, "root_at_first": str(hs.pos), "root_at_last": str(S()[i_end - 1].pos), "moved_down_px": moved, "fire_height_at_first": hs.h})

	var last: Dictionary = S()[i_end - 1]
	var off: Dictionary = S()[i_end]
	c = {"last_hosing_frame": brief(last), "first_frame_not_hosing": brief(off), "linger_s": (i_end - z) * frame_s, "hosing_s": (i_end - i_h) * frame_s,
		"frames_checked_after": S().size() - i_end, "visible": off.vis, "emitters_visible": off.shown}
	check("stops-with-hosing", last.hosing and both(last.emit, true) and both(last.ratio, 0.0) and both(off.emit, false) and off.water == 0
		and all_of(i_end, S().size(), func(s): return not s.hosing and both(s.emit, false) and s.id == steam_id and s.steams == 1 and s.vis and both(s.shown, true)), c)

	# --- B-R1: not on R (R after the water has stopped) ---
	s0 = S().size()
	await tap(KEY_R)
	await steps(30)
	c = brief(S().back())
	c.merge({"player_at": str(game.player.position)})
	check("none-on-restart", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.player.position.distance_to(SPAWN) < 1.0
		and all_of(s0, S().size(), func(s): return not s.hosing and both(s.emit, false)), c)

	# --- Attempt 2: B-R5 game pause (Esc) at 1.5 s, B-R5 tree pause at 2.5 s, B-R7 R at 3.0 s ---
	await hose()
	await wait_for(func(): return game.extinguish_ticks > 0 and game.extinguish_ticks <= EXT - 90, 200)
	var esc_from := S().size()
	await tap(KEY_ESCAPE)
	await steps(60)
	await tap(KEY_ENTER)
	await steps(10)
	var esc_to := S().size()
	var held: Array = range(esc_from, esc_to).filter(func(i): return S()[i].state == Game.State.PAUSED)
	var esc_ok := held.size() >= 60
	var p0: Dictionary = S()[held[0]] if esc_ok else {}
	if esc_ok:
		for i in held:
			var s: Dictionary = S()[i]
			esc_ok = esc_ok and s.hosing and both(s.emit, true) and s.ext == p0.ext and s.water == p0.water and s.ratio == p0.ratio and s.pos == p0.pos and both(s.proc, true) and not s.paused
		esc_ok = esc_ok and p0.ratio[0] > 0.0 and p0.ratio[0] < 1.0 and ratio_ok(p0) and S()[held[0] - 1].ratio == p0.ratio and S()[esc_to - 1].ratio[0] < p0.ratio[0]
	check("game-pause-holds", esc_ok,
		{"paused_frames": held.size(), "at_pause": brief(p0) if not p0.is_empty() else {}, "emitters_processing_while_paused": p0.get("proc"), "tree_paused": p0.get("paused"),
		"after_resume": brief(S()[esc_to - 1])})

	await wait_for(func(): return game.extinguish_ticks > 0 and game.extinguish_ticks <= EXT - 150, 200)
	await physics_frame
	paused = true   # set before this tick's physics: the session stops on the values the driver last wrote
	var tp_from := S().size()
	await process_frame
	await steps(59)
	await physics_frame
	paused = false
	var tp_to := S().size()
	await process_frame
	await steps(10)
	var before: Dictionary = S()[tp_from - 1]
	var frozen: Array = range(tp_from, tp_to).filter(func(i): return S()[i].paused)
	var tree_ok: bool = frozen.size() >= 60 and before.hosing and not before.paused
	for i in frozen:
		var s: Dictionary = S()[i]
		tree_ok = tree_ok and s.hosing and s.h == before.h and s.ext == before.ext and s.water == before.water and s.emit == before.emit and s.ratio == before.ratio
		tree_ok = tree_ok and s.pos == before.pos and s.vis and both(s.shown, true) and both(s.proc, false)
	tree_ok = tree_ok and S()[S().size() - 1].ext < before.ext
	check("tree-pause-holds", tree_ok,
		{"paused_frames": frozen.size(), "before_pause": brief(before), "while_paused": brief(S()[tp_to - 1]) if tp_to > tp_from else {},
		"emitters_processing_while_paused": S()[tp_to - 1].proc if tp_to > tp_from else [], "emitters_visible_while_paused": S()[tp_to - 1].shown if tp_to > tp_from else [],
		"extinguish_ticks_after": S().back().ext})

	await wait_for(func(): return game.extinguish_ticks > 0 and game.extinguish_ticks <= EXT - 180, 200)
	var r_from := S().size()
	await tap(KEY_R)
	await steps(60)
	var i_off := first_from(r_from, func(s): return not s.hosing)
	var r_ok := i_off > r_from
	if r_ok:
		var on: Dictionary = S()[i_off - 1]
		var r: Dictionary = S()[i_off]
		r_ok = on.hosing and both(on.emit, true) and on.water > 1 and both(r.emit, false) and r.state == Game.State.PLAYING and r.water == 0 and r.ext == 0
		r_ok = r_ok and r.p.distance_to(SPAWN) < 1.0 and all_of(i_off, S().size(), func(s): return not s.hosing and both(s.emit, false))
	check("restart-stops", r_ok,
		{"last_hosing_frame": brief(S()[i_off - 1]) if i_off > 0 else {}, "first_frame_after_R": brief(S()[i_off]) if i_off >= 0 else {},
		"player_after_R": str(S()[i_off].p) if i_off >= 0 else "", "frames_checked_after": S().size() - i_off})

	# --- Attempt 3: B-R1 again after R, then B-R7 fire death during hosing (D held into the fire) ---
	var a3: int = await hose()
	await wait_for(func(): return game.extinguish_ticks > 0 and game.extinguish_ticks <= EXT - 60, 100)
	var i_h3 := first_from(a3, func(s): return s.hosing)
	var again_ok := i_h3 > a3 and both(S()[i_h3 - 1].emit, false) and both(S()[i_h3].emit, true) and absf(S()[i_h3].ratio[0] - 1.0) <= tol and pos_ok(S()[i_h3])
	check("starts-again-after-restart", again_ok, {"first_hosing_frame": brief(S()[i_h3]) if i_h3 >= 0 else {}, "tolerance": tol})
	key(KEY_D, true)
	var died: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.state == Game.State.DYING, 90)
	key(KEY_D, false)
	var back: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.state == Game.State.PLAYING, 200)
	await steps(30)
	var d0 := first_from(a3, func(s): return s.state == Game.State.DYING)
	var d1 := first_from(d0, func(s): return s.state != Game.State.DYING) if d0 >= 0 else -1
	var death_ok: bool = died and back and d0 > 0 and d1 > d0 and game.death_reason == "The fire got you."
	if death_ok:
		var dy: Dictionary = S()[d0]
		death_ok = dy.ratio[0] > 0.0 and dy.ratio[0] < 1.0 and all_of(d0, d1, func(s): return s.hosing and both(s.emit, true) and s.ratio == dy.ratio and s.pos == dy.pos)
		death_ok = death_ok and S()[d1].state == Game.State.PLAYING and not S()[d1].hosing and both(S()[d1].emit, false)
	check("fire-death-holds", death_ok,
		{"died": died, "death_reason": game.death_reason, "dying_frames": d1 - d0, "dying_s": (d1 - d0) * frame_s, "at_death": brief(S()[d0]) if d0 >= 0 else {},
		"last_dying_frame": brief(S()[d1 - 1]) if d1 > 0 else {}, "first_frame_after_restart": brief(S()[d1]) if d1 >= 0 else {}})

	# --- Attempt 4: B-R6 hidden from before W until after the water stops ---
	steam.visible = false
	var a4: int = await hose()
	await wait_for(func(): return game.player.hosing, 10)
	await wait_for(func(): return not game.player.hosing, 400)
	await steps(10)
	var hid_to := S().size()
	steam.visible = true
	await steps(5)
	var i_h4 := first_from(a4, func(s): return s.hosing)
	var i_e4 := first_from(i_h4, func(s): return not s.hosing) if i_h4 >= 0 else -1
	var hid_ok := i_h4 > a4 and i_e4 > i_h4 and i_e4 < hid_to
	var hid_ratios := {}
	if hid_ok:
		for i in range(i_h4, i_e4):
			hid_ratios[snappedf(S()[i].ratio[0], 1e-6)] = true
		hid_ok = all_of(a4, hid_to, func(s): return not s.vis and both(s.shown, false)) and both(S()[i_h4 - 1].emit, false) and both(S()[i_h4].emit, true)
		hid_ok = hid_ok and both(S()[i_e4].emit, false) and hid_ratios.size() >= 2 and all_of(i_h4, i_e4, func(s): return ratio_ok(s) and pos_ok(s))
	check("hidden-still-driven", hid_ok,
		{"hidden_frames": hid_to - a4, "hosing_frames_while_hidden": i_e4 - i_h4, "distinct_ratios_while_hidden": hid_ratios.size(),
		"first_hosing_frame": brief(S()[i_h4]) if i_h4 >= 0 else {}, "first_frame_not_hosing": brief(S()[i_e4]) if i_e4 >= 0 else {},
		"emitters_visible_while_hidden": S()[i_h4].shown if i_h4 >= 0 else [], "visible_again": S().back().vis})

	# --- over the whole run ---
	var bad_emit := 0
	var bad_ratio := 0
	var bad_pos := 0
	var bad_amount := 0
	var hosing_frames := 0
	for s in S():
		if s.emit != [s.hosing, s.hosing]:
			bad_emit += 1
		if s.amount != AMOUNTS:
			bad_amount += 1
		if s.hosing:
			hosing_frames += 1
			if not ratio_ok(s):
				bad_ratio += 1
			if not pos_ok(s):
				bad_pos += 1
	check("every-frame", hosing_frames > 0 and bad_emit == 0 and bad_ratio == 0 and bad_pos == 0 and bad_amount == 0,
		{"frames": S().size(), "hosing_frames": hosing_frames, "emitting_not_hosing": bad_emit, "ratio_off_rule": bad_ratio, "root_off_fire_top": bad_pos, "amount_changed": bad_amount})
	var one := S().filter(func(s): return s.steams == 1 and s.id == steam_id and s.parent_ok).size()
	check("one-steam-in-level", one == S().size() and kids == KIDS,
		{"frames": S().size(), "frames_with_the_same_one_steam_in_the_level": one, "children": kids})
	var behind := S().filter(func(s): return s.idx >= 0 and s.idx < s.pidx).size()
	var with_puff := S().filter(func(s): return s.puffs > 0).size()
	check("steam-behind-player", behind == S().size() and with_puff > 0,
		{"frames": S().size(), "frames_steam_index_below_player": behind, "frames_with_a_live_puff": with_puff, "steam_index_at_end": S().back().idx, "player_index_at_end": S().back().pidx})
	finish()

func finish() -> void:
	print("HOSE STEAM STATE: %d checks / %d failures (physics tick %.6f s, frame %.6f s)" % [results.size(), failures, 1.0 / Engine.physics_ticks_per_second, frame_s])
	game.queue_free()
	await process_frame
	quit(1 if failures else 0)

extends SceneTree
# A6 CPU price of the two effects (CHANGE-BRIEF C), headless. Adapted from the chapter's Example 09 cost
# script (a6/evidence/probes/particle_cost_example09.gd): the same warm-up frames, timed frames, repeats
# and wall-clock timer. At a fixed rate (--fixed-fps) Godot never sleeps between frames, so the time
# between two frames is the CPU time of one whole frame: physics, process, the dummy render and this
# script's own loop.
# Run: scripts/run-test.sh cost_effects.gd 60 300
# Cases, each REPEATS x TIMED_FRAMES frames:
#   empty scene         Example 09's baseline: a bare Node2D, no game. Mostly the main loop and this loop.
#   game, effects off   res://game/main.tscn in PLAYING, him standing at the spawn. Both drivers are in, no
#                       JumpPuff is alive and the level's HoseSteam is not emitting.
#   Effect A            the same with two JumpPuffs alive on every timed frame (A-R3: at most 2, so 34
#                       particles). The test emits player.landed whenever fewer than 2 are alive, so the
#                       real driver instances, places and frees every puff.
#   Effect B            the same with a second HoseSteam from hose_steam.tscn at the full fire's top, both
#                       emitters emitting at amount_ratio 1.0 (54 particles), filled during the warm-up.
# Neither peak can be held with real keys: landings come at least ~0.65 s apart and a puff lives 0.88 s,
# so two overlap only briefly, and amount_ratio is 1.0 only on the first hosing frame. So the test makes
# both states. For B it writes only what the brief gives a driver (emitting, amount_ratio, the root
# position), on its own instance; the level's own steam is left to its driver.
# The three game cases run round by round (off, A, B, off, A, B, ...), so slow drift hits all three alike,
# and each case starts with R, a fresh attempt, so the 40 s level timer never runs out mid-case. Every case
# runs the same per-frame loop, so the loop's own cost is inside every number.
# What this cannot see: GPU work and drawing. Headless Godot uses a dummy renderer (CLAUDE.md, Headless
# facts): Effect B's particles are never processed, so its price here is near zero by construction.
const Main = preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
const HoseSteam := preload("res://effects/hose_steam.tscn")
const PUFF_PATH := "res://effects/jump_puff.tscn"
const WARM_UP_FRAMES := 120   # 2.0 s at 60 fps: longer than Haze's 1.6 s life, so B's steam has filled
const TIMED_FRAMES := 300
const REPEATS := 10
const SETTLE_FRAMES := 60     # after each case, so A's last puffs (0.88 s) are gone before the next one
const MAX_PUFFS := 2          # A-R3: at most 2 alive at once
const LANDING_GAP_S := 0.43   # at least this between two landings: under half a puff's measured 0.8833 s
                              # (logs/test_jump_puff_state_60fps.log), so two stay alive and a third never starts
const AMOUNTS := [14, 40]     # B3: Haze, Steam
const EMPTY := "empty scene"
const OFF := "game, effects off"
const PUFFS := "Effect A, 2 puffs alive"
const STEAM := "Effect B, ratio 1.0"
var game: Node2D
var level_steam: Array = []   # the level's own HoseSteam emitters (hose_steam_driver.gd), read only
var fixture: Node2D           # Effect B's HoseSteam, the test's own instance
var keep_puffs := false
var live_puffs := 0
var puffs_made := 0
var frame := 0
var last_landing := -1000
var landing_gap := 26
var cases := {}               # name -> {means, ms, alive_min, alive_max, landings, problems}
var flagged := 0

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")

# Synthetic key event through Godot Input, as test_keyboard.gd and the A6 state tests.
func key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode = code
	event.physical_keycode = code
	event.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func tap(code: Key) -> void:
	key(code, true)
	await frames(2)
	key(code, false)
	await frames(1)

# Example 09's time_frames(), one frame at a time: the wall time between two process_frame signals, and
# the puffs alive in that frame. Warm-up, settle and timed frames all run this same loop.
func frames(count: int) -> Dictionary:
	var ms: Array[float] = []
	var alive: Array[int] = []
	var last := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	for i in count:
		frame += 1
		if keep_puffs and live_puffs < MAX_PUFFS and frame - last_landing >= landing_gap:
			game.player.landed.emit()
			last_landing = frame
		alive.append(live_puffs)
		await process_frame
		var now := Time.get_ticks_usec()
		ms.append((now - last) / 1000.0)
		last = now
	return {"ms": ms, "alive": alive}

# --- watchers: they count puffs, never touch them ---

func _on_node_added(node: Node) -> void:
	if node.scene_file_path == PUFF_PATH:
		live_puffs += 1
		puffs_made += 1
		node.tree_exited.connect(_on_puff_exited)

func _on_puff_exited() -> void:
	live_puffs -= 1

# --- the cases ---

# Where hose_steam_driver.gd puts the level's steam: the fire's top centre (B-R4), at full height here.
func fire_top() -> Vector2:
	var fire: Array = game.level.blocking_fire
	return Vector2(float(fire[0]) + float(fire[2]) / 2.0, float(fire[1]) + float(fire[3]) - game.fire_height())

func start_case(name: String) -> void:
	if name == PUFFS:
		keep_puffs = true
		last_landing = -1000
	elif name == STEAM:
		fixture = HoseSteam.instantiate()
		fixture.position = fire_top()
		game.add_child(fixture)
		game.move_child(fixture, game.player.get_index())   # just before him, as the driver does (Revision 5)
		for e in fixture.get_children():
			e.amount_ratio = 1.0
			e.emitting = true

func end_case() -> void:
	keep_puffs = false
	if fixture:
		fixture.queue_free()
		fixture = null

func snapshot() -> Dictionary:
	var s := {"state": game.state, "deaths": game.deaths, "on_floor": game.player.is_on_floor(), "made": puffs_made,
		"level_emit": level_steam.map(func(e): return e.emitting), "fix_emit": [], "fix_ratio": [], "fix_amount": []}
	if fixture:
		for e in fixture.get_children():
			s.fix_emit.append(e.emitting)
			s.fix_ratio.append(e.amount_ratio)
			s.fix_amount.append(e.amount)
	return s

func problem(c: Dictionary, text: String) -> void:
	if not text in c.problems:
		c.problems.append(text)

# One repeat: its mean goes into the case, and the checks that it measured what the case's name says.
func record(name: String, res: Dictionary, before: Dictionary, after: Dictionary) -> void:
	var c: Dictionary = cases[name]
	c.means.append(mean(res.ms))
	c.ms.append_array(res.ms)
	var alive: Array = res.alive
	c.alive_min = mini(c.alive_min, alive.min())
	c.alive_max = maxi(c.alive_max, alive.max())
	var want := MAX_PUFFS if name == PUFFS else 0
	if alive.min() != want or alive.max() != want:
		problem(c, "puffs alive per timed frame %d-%d, want %d" % [alive.min(), alive.max(), want])
	if before.is_empty():
		return
	c.landings += after.made - before.made
	for s in [before, after]:
		if s.state != Game.State.PLAYING or s.deaths != before.deaths or not s.on_floor:
			problem(c, "not PLAYING on the floor throughout (state %d, deaths %d -> %d)" % [s.state, before.deaths, s.deaths])
		if s.level_emit != [false, false]:
			problem(c, "the level's own steam was emitting: %s" % [s.level_emit])
		if name == STEAM and (s.fix_emit != [true, true] or s.fix_ratio != [1.0, 1.0] or s.fix_amount != AMOUNTS):
			problem(c, "steam not at its heaviest: emitting %s, amount_ratio %s, amount %s" % [s.fix_emit, s.fix_ratio, s.fix_amount])

func game_case(name: String) -> void:
	await tap(KEY_R)
	start_case(name)
	await frames(WARM_UP_FRAMES)
	var before := snapshot()
	var res: Dictionary = await frames(TIMED_FRAMES)
	var after := snapshot()
	end_case()
	await frames(SETTLE_FRAMES)
	record(name, res, before, after)

# --- the report ---

func mean(values: Array) -> float:
	var total := 0.0
	for v in values:
		total += v
	return total / values.size()

func sd(values: Array) -> float:
	var m := mean(values)
	var total := 0.0
	for v in values:
		total += (v - m) * (v - m)
	return sqrt(total / (values.size() - 1))

func report(name: String) -> void:
	var c: Dictionary = cases[name]
	var sorted: Array = c.ms.duplicate()
	sorted.sort()
	print("%-24s mean %.6f ms/frame | spread over %d repeats: sd %.6f, min %.6f, max %.6f | per frame (%d): median %.6f, p95 %.6f"
		% [name, mean(c.means), c.means.size(), sd(c.means), c.means.min(), c.means.max(), sorted.size(),
		sorted[floori(sorted.size() * 0.5)], sorted[floori(sorted.size() * 0.95)]])
	print("%-24s repeat means: %s" % ["", ", ".join(PackedStringArray(c.means.map(func(m): return "%.6f" % m)))])
	var detail := "puffs alive per timed frame %d-%d" % [c.alive_min, c.alive_max]
	if name == PUFFS:
		detail += ", %d landings emitted in timed frames (%.1f per repeat)" % [c.landings, float(c.landings) / c.means.size()]
	elif name == STEAM:
		detail += ", its own HoseSteam emitting at amount_ratio 1.0 with amount %s at the start and end of every timed window" % [AMOUNTS]
	if name != EMPTY:
		detail += ", PLAYING on the floor, the level's own steam not emitting"
	print("%-24s checks: %s; %s" % ["", "OK" if c.problems.is_empty() else "PROBLEM: " + "; ".join(PackedStringArray(c.problems)), detail])

# Two cases read the same when their repeat-mean ranges overlap: the difference is inside the spread.
func compare(a: String, b: String, should_differ: bool, why: String) -> void:
	var ma: Array = cases[a].means
	var mb: Array = cases[b].means
	var diff := mean(ma) - mean(mb)
	var same: bool = maxf(ma.min(), mb.min()) <= minf(ma.max(), mb.max())
	print("%s vs %s: %+.6f ms/frame (%+.1f %%) -> %s" % [a, b, diff, 100.0 * diff / mean(mb),
		"SAME within spread (repeat ranges overlap)" if same else "DIFFERENT (repeat ranges apart)"])
	if same and should_differ:
		flagged += 1
		print("  FLAG: these should differ (%s) but read the same: the script may be measuring itself, not the effect." % why)
	elif same:
		print("  same, as expected headless (%s): this number is the game and the script, not the effect." % why)
	elif not should_differ:
		flagged += 1
		print("  FLAG: expected the same headless (%s) but they differ: something besides the effect changed." % why)
	else:
		print("  differ, as expected (%s)." % why)

func run() -> void:
	var adapter := RenderingServer.get_video_adapter_name()
	print("Rendering method: ", RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method())
	print("Video adapter: \"%s\"%s" % [adapter, " (empty: dummy renderer, nothing is drawn and no GPU particle process runs)" if adapter == "" else ""])
	node_added.connect(_on_node_added)
	for name in [EMPTY, OFF, PUFFS, STEAM]:
		cases[name] = {"means": [], "ms": [], "alive_min": 1 << 30, "alive_max": -1, "landings": 0, "problems": []}

	# --- a fixed rate: every frame advances the game clock by the same step, and nothing sleeps ---
	var ticks_from := Engine.get_physics_frames()
	var deltas: Array[float] = []
	for i in 30:
		await process_frame
		deltas.append(root.get_process_delta_time())
	var step: float = deltas[0]
	var fixed: bool = deltas.max() - deltas.min() < 1e-9
	print("Frame step %.6f s (%s), %.2f physics ticks per frame; %d warm-up + %d timed frames x %d repeats per case"
		% [step, "fixed" if fixed else "NOT fixed", float(Engine.get_physics_frames() - ticks_from) / deltas.size(), WARM_UP_FRAMES, TIMED_FRAMES, REPEATS])
	if not fixed:
		print("COST EFFECTS: not at a fixed rate, so every case would read the frame sleep (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts). Run with --fixed-fps.")
		quit(1)
		return
	landing_gap = maxi(1, floori(LANDING_GAP_S / step))

	# --- empty scene: Example 09's baseline ---
	var container := Node2D.new()
	root.add_child(container)
	await frames(WARM_UP_FRAMES)
	for r in REPEATS:
		var res: Dictionary = await frames(TIMED_FRAMES)
		record(EMPTY, res, {}, {})
	container.queue_free()
	await frames(2)

	# --- the game, started with Enter; then off, A, B, round by round ---
	game = Main.instantiate()
	game.test_mode = true
	root.add_child(game)
	level_steam = game.player.get_node("HoseSteamDriver").emitters
	await frames(30)
	await tap(KEY_ENTER)

# script (a6/evidence/probes/particle_cost_example09.gd): the same warm-up frames, timed frames, repeats
# and wall-clock timer. At a fixed rate (--fixed-fps) Godot never sleeps between frames, so the time
# between two frames is the CPU time of one whole frame: physics, process, the dummy render and this
# script's own loop.
# Run: scripts/run-test.sh cost_effects.gd 60 300
# Cases, each REPEATS x TIMED_FRAMES frames:
#   empty scene         Example 09's baseline: a bare Node2D, no game. Mostly the main loop and this loop.
#   game, effects off   res://game/main.tscn in PLAYING, him standing at the spawn. Both drivers are in, no
#                       JumpPuff is alive and the level's HoseSteam is not emitting.
#   Effect A            the same with two JumpPuffs alive on every timed frame (A-R3: at most 2, so 34
#                       particles). The test emits player.landed whenever fewer than 2 are alive, so the
#                       real driver instances, places and frees every puff.
#   Effect B            the same with a second HoseSteam from hose_steam.tscn at the full fire's top, both
#                       emitters emitting at amount_ratio 1.0 (54 particles), filled during the warm-up.
# Neither peak can be held with real keys: landings come at least ~0.65 s apart and a puff lives 0.88 s,
# so two overlap only briefly, and amount_ratio is 1.0 only on the first hosing frame. So the test makes
# both states. For B it writes only what the brief gives a driver (emitting, amount_ratio, the root
# position), on its own instance; the level's own steam is left to its driver.
# The three game cases run round by round (off, A, B, off, A, B, ...), so slow drift hits all three alike,
# and each case starts with R, a fresh attempt, so the 40 s level timer never runs out mid-case. Every case
# runs the same per-frame loop, so the loop's own cost is inside every number.
# What this cannot see: GPU work and drawing. Headless Godot uses a dummy renderer (CLAUDE.md, Headless
# facts): Effect B's particles are never processed, so its price here is near zero by construction.
const Main = preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
const HoseSteam := preload("res://effects/hose_steam.tscn")
const PUFF_PATH := "res://effects/jump_puff.tscn"
const WARM_UP_FRAMES := 120   # 2.0 s at 60 fps: longer than Haze's 1.6 s life, so B's steam has filled

func frames(count: int) -> Dictionary:
	var ms: Array[float] = []

	var total := 0.0
	for v in values:
		total += v
	return total / values.size()

func sd(values: Array) -> float:
	var m := mean(values)
	var total := 0.0
	for v in values:
		total += (v - m) * (v - m)
	return sqrt(total / (values.size() - 1))

	print("%-24s repeat means: %s" % ["", ", ".join(PackedStringArray(c.means.map(func(m): return "%.6f" % m)))])

I wrote `godot/tests/cost_effects.gd` and ran it with `./scripts/run-test.sh cost_effects.gd 60 300`. It exited 0 and every setup check passed. Nothing is committed, and no effect, gameplay, test or runner file changed. The only new files are the script and its log, `logs/cost_effects_60fps.log`.

## How the cases are set up

Example 09's timing is kept: warm-up frames, then 300 timed frames, timed by the wall clock. At `--fixed-fps` Godot doesn't sleep between frames, so the wall clock gives CPU time per frame. There are 10 repeats instead of 3. The three game cases run in alternating rounds (off, A, B, off, A, B, …), each starting with R so the 40 s level timer never runs out.

- **Effect A, 2 puffs alive:** real keys can't keep two puffs alive at once, because landings come at least about 0.65 s apart. So the script fires `player.landed` whenever fewer than 2 puffs are alive, at least 0.43 s apart. The real driver then creates, places and frees every puff. The log confirms exactly 2 puffs were alive on every timed frame.
- **Effect B, ratio 1.0:** a second `HoseSteam` sits at the fire's top, both emitters on at `amount_ratio` 1.0 and amounts unchanged at 14 and 40. That state is checked at the start and end of every timed window. The level's own steam is left to its driver and stays off.

## What it means

- **Effect B reads the same as "effects off"** (+0.0002 ms, higher in only 4 of 10 rounds). This is the case where the script measures itself plus the game, not the steam. That's expected, because headless runs no GPU particle work. Its price has to come from the GPU run, not this script.
- **Effect A costs about +0.005 ms per frame,** higher than "effects off" in all 10 rounds. That's about 0.03 % of a 16.7 ms frame and well under your 0.1 ms budget. The figure covers creating and freeing about 11 puffs per 300 frames as well as simulating the 34 particles. Example 09's rate alone would predict about 0.002 ms for 34 particles.
- **Empty vs game, and A vs B, differ clearly.** No pair that should differ reads the same in this run.

## Two things you should know

1. **I changed the comparison rule after the first run.** The first run counted two cases as the same if their ranges of repeat results overlapped. By that rule it flagged A vs "effects off" and A vs B as the same, so possibly the script measuring itself. But A was higher than "effects off" in 9 of its 10 rounds even then. Because the rounds alternate, I switched the game cases to a round-by-round comparison: "different" if the average per-round difference is more than 2 standard errors from zero. This is a rough rule with only 10 rounds. The empty scene still uses the range rule, since it runs on its own before the game.
2. **Results drift between runs.** "Effects off" was 0.202 ms in the first run and 0.173 ms in the second, a 15 % shift, about six times the size of Effect A's cost. Compare cases within one run only, never numbers from different runs.
